messages:
sam: Quick follow-up from yesterday's soak: saw a tenant compaction cause ~110ms microbatch stalls for other tenants. Putting the logs and a proposal here.

maria: can you paste the log snippet? was that compact running on the host pool or per-tenant arena?

sam: host pool compaction. snippet: 
```
[2026-03-20T09:11:02Z] compact: arena=0 candidates=412 reclaimed=2.4MB
[2026-03-20T09:11:02Z] compact: acquired-global-compact-lock
[2026-03-20T09:11:02Z] tenant=C microbatch: wait_for_alloc 112ms
```

alex: So compact currently holds a global mutex that touches allocator free lists and some metrics. That serializes tiny alloc/free. We expected compaction to be background-y.

jin: Correct. Our current path: per-arena locks, then global compact lock for skyline bookkeeping and metric aggregation. That global section is small but can be hit repeatedly during a long compaction.

natalie: Two mitigation ideas: (1) split metric aggregation out of the compact critical section, and (2) add an allocator.reserve_soft API where microbatches can draw from a small emergency pool that doesn't require the global lock.

sam: Draft API: allocator.reserve_soft(tenant, bytes) -> bool. If true, allocation returns from emergency staging which doesn't touch compact metrics. If false, caller falls back to host staging or route swap.

maria: Fairness question: a noisy tenant could keep using soft reserves and hog the emergency pool. How to gate usage?

alex: Token-bucket per-tenant. Track soft_reserve_tokens; allocator returns false once bucket empty. Refill per minute.

jin: Another complementary change: make compaction cooperative. Break long compaction into short slices (e.g., 20-30ms) and yield the global lock between slices. This reduces worst-case hold time. My POC shows stall drops from ~110ms to ~25-35ms with slice=25ms, at cost of ~15% longer total compaction work.

natalie: Combine both: cooperative compaction reduces average hold time; soft reserve addresses rare tail spikes. Add guardrails to auto-disable soft for tenants exceeding abuse threshold.

sam: Proposed rollout: 
- Phase A: add reserve_soft API + token-bucket controller + dry-run telemetry (no behavioral change). 1 week soak.
- Phase B: implement compactor slicing + remove metric aggregation from compact global lock. 2 week soak.


alex: Quota policy example (yaml):
```yaml
tenant_policies:
  tenant-corp-a:
    soft_reserve_enabled: true
    soft_quota_per_minute: 30
    soft_auto_disable_pct: 95
```

maria: Edge cases: KV cache pinning and locality. If emergency pool allocations land on different backing memory, we could evict KV cache pins or change locality. Need invariant: soft-reserved allocations must preserve KVCACHE pin semantics or be marked as "no_kvcache" and only used for non-KV paths.

jin: Also: make sure fallback routing is clear. reserve_soft -> host_staging_alloc -> route_to_smaller_model. Avoid double-counting tokens when host_staging is used. Count tokens only when reserve_soft succeeds. 

natalie: Telemetry we want: soft_reserve_attempts, soft_reserve_success, soft_reserve_denied, compaction_hold_ms_by_arena, per-tenant stall_ms. Add alert when a tenant exceeds auto-disable threshold.

infra-bot: CI: branch "soft-reserve-slice" build passed; unit tests 58/58.

maria: Good. Ops asks for a dry-run mode to measure expected usage before we enforce limits. Also default soft_reserve_enabled=false for Hosted free tier.

sam: Action items: sam->RFC diff + perf writeup; alex->auto-disable sketch; jin->compactor slice POC; natalie->ops guardrails + telemetry dashboards; maria->soak plan and e2e. I'll open the PR today.

alex: :thumbsup:

infra-bot: reminder: offload-telemetry sync tomorrow 10:30am

sam: thanks all.
